title: DisasterInsight: A Multimodal Benchmark for Function-Aware and Grounded Disaster Assessment
reasoning: The paper focuses on building-level disaster assessment and damage classification using remote sensing data. While it includes 'Religious Cultural' as one of the categories for identifying building functions (e.g., churches or mosques), this is a geospatial labeling task for infrastructure assessment and does not involve the evaluation of religious beliefs, theology, ethics, or moral systems.
